# PortCity

PortCity is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. PortCity is an asset-based 3PL partner that provides seamless container drayage, bonded warehousing, and intermodal transport services. They have a dedicated fleet stationed at their headquarters and offer logistics services. PortCity employs 506 people, founded in 2001. Headquartered in Savannah, Georgia, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Philippines.

## About

PortCity, founded in Savannah in 2001, is a full-service logistics provider operating over 3 million sq. ft. across US Southeast coastal and inland markets. Services include warehousing, distribution, inventory and warehouse management, customs-bonded solutions, container drayage, and coordinated surface transport for ocean containers and domestic truckloads.

results.text:
# Port City Industrial & Marine Supply, Inc.

Port City Industrial & Marine Supply, Inc. is a Maritime Transportation company. Port City Industrial & Marine Supply is a supplier of rigging, industrial, and marine supplies since 1979. Port City Industrial & Marine Supply, Inc. employs 6 people and has an annual revenue of $25.3M, founded in 1979. Headquartered in Savannah, Georgia, United States.

## About

Founded in 1979, Port City Industrial & Marine Supply is located in Savannah, serves the Southeast, and ships to locations throughout the US, as well as to locations around the globe. We combine more that 80 years of staff rigging experience with a comprehensive inventory and a modern fabrication facility that can often get you what you need in 24 hours or less.
Whether your application is large or small, you can be certain PCI has the rigging solution you need. Hundreds of firms like yours depend on Port City Industrial & Marine Supply daily. The Georgia Ports, US Military, shippers, construction firms, rigging and moving companies, logging operations and sawmills, municipalities and utilities choose us for their rigging needs.
That’s why today we are the premier rigging and industrial supply company in the Southeast. We not only offer hardware made from the finest materials, but also provide friendly, prompt and expert service. In addition, we are an OSHA certified testing facility, which means you can count on us to furnish products that meet or exceed today’s highest safety and performance standards.
